† גְּשׁוּרִי adj.gent. = subst. הַגּ׳;
1. people dwelling in Geshûr (supr.) Dt 3:14 Jos 12:5; 13:11, 13.
2. a tribe of, or near, the Philistines Jos 13:2, read prob. הַגִּזְרִי We and Dr (on 1 S 27:8), MeyZAW i. 126 n GFM Ju 1:29 n. also 1 S 27:8, but del 𝔊 (not 𝔊L) cf. We Dr; read possibly אשׁורי Hom Aufsätze i. (1892), 9; 2 S 2:9 read הגּ׳ for האשׁורי.
